profile.headline: Team Lead/Sr Software Developer, State of Oregon

positions.title: Team Lead/Sr Software Developer
positions.description: Software development on iSeries utilizing COBOL, SQL

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description: Development and customization to the core health insurance application on the IBM iSeries utilizing COBOL/400, ILE, CLP, embedded SQL, Stored Procedures, Aldon software management tool.  Responsible for creating technical specifications from user requirements along with determining time frames and budget.  Worked closely with off-shore resources to develop interfaces into the core application along with passing secured data to external sites. Projects implemented using the Agile methodology.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
Development and customization to the education software system using COBOL/400, RPG/400 SQL, Query/400 and CL.  Programs written included sub-file processing, screen designs, reports, and batch update processing.
	
Assist in the implementation of several projects including utilizing third party applications such as COGNOS, ETL, and Crypto Complete data encryption.

positions.title: IT Manager
positions.description: Responsible for leading a team of programmers, business analysts and QA staff through the implementations of new accounts using the SDCL process and waterfall methodology.  Implementations include development and modifications of the production system utilizing both COBOL, Java and XML.

positions.title: IT Manager & Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for leading a team of senior and junior level programmers through development and modifications of the banks software system.  This included teaching AS/400 and RPG/400 skills to junior level programmers, organizing and developing class material, writing technical specifications, and assisting with daily assignments.

Development and customization to the banks software system using RPG/400, Query/400 and CL.  Programs written included sub-file processing, screen designs, reports, and batch update processing.
	
Responsible for programming and project management of six conversions from various platforms to the core banking database.  RPG/400 programs were developed for the migration of demand deposit, savings, certificate deposit, and loan accounts.
